roles.title: Vice President, Growth and Category
roles.pnl: ₹1,400 crore GMV at an 11% contribution margin
responsibilities: Owns the P&L for grocery, home and personal care.
Chairs the weekly pricing council with finance and supply chain.

achievements.text: Grew GMV from ₹820 crore to ₹1,400 crore in three years while lifting contribution margin from 7% to 11%.
Launched private label across 9 categories; it is now 13% of category revenue.
Cut out-of-stock rate from 8.4% to 3.1% with the supply chain team.
Built and led a team of 46 across category, pricing and growth.
Ran the grocery category at ₹310 crore GMV and renegotiated terms with 140 brands for 2.4 points of back margin.
Set up city-level pricing in 27 cities.
Advises the founders one day a month; helped the brand enter 3 modern-trade chains.

roles.title: Regional Category Lead, South-East Asia
roles.pnl: SGD 95 million category revenue across 4 markets

achievements.text: Managed SGD 95 million of category revenue across 4 markets: Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam.
Moved 35% of sourcing to regional suppliers, reducing landed cost by 6%.
Bought a 1,200-line ambient range for 310 stores.
Built pricing models for 5 retail clients.
